description: This file declares exported API functions for a message object related to filtering requests and responses in a communication system, including creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization functions.
external_files: http headers or other external API headers that might define ANSC_HANDLE and ANSC_STATUS

methods.name: CfFRComponentCreate
methods.description: Creates a filter request message object with specified container, owner, and reserved handles.

methods.name: CfFRCOCreate
methods.description: Creates a filter request control object with specified context handles.

methods.name: CfFRCOEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls objects for the filter request control object.

methods.name: CfFRCOInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the filter request control object.

methods.name: CfFPComponentCreate
methods.description: Creates a filtering response message object.

methods.name: CfFPCOCreate
methods.description: Creates a filtering response control object.

methods.name: CfFPCOEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls objects for the filtering response control object.

methods.name: CfFPCOInitialize
